+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+bats_require_minimum_version 1.5.0
+# =============================================================================
+# tests/unit/run-checkpoint-derive.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 2 Task 2.10
+# (PRD FR-5 AC-5.1 … AC-5.4, FR-4(f) AC-4.6; SDD D-5.1, D-5.1a, D-5.2, D-5.3, D-5.4)
+# `run-checkpoint.sh derive` rebuilds the run position from files: one case per
+# decision-table row, the breaker recompute from the feedback history, the
+# write path and its rollback knob, and one case per known reader over a
+# derived file. Fixture: a tiny git repo with a ledger, a2a/ and .run/ in a
+# temp dir; nothing touches this checkout's .run/.
+# =============================================================================
+
+setup() {
+  REPO="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd)"
+  CK="$REPO/.claude/scripts/run-checkpoint.sh"
+  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/rcd.XXXXXX")"
+  R="$T/repo"
+  mkdir -p "$R/grimoires/loa/a2a" "$R/.run" "$R/src"
+  git -C "$R" init -q
+  printf 'x\n' > "$R/src/a.ts"
+  git -C "$R" add -A
+  git -C "$R" -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@example.invalid commit -qm "feat: impl"
+  ledger completed completed completed
+  unset LOA_RUN_DIR LOA_IMPLEMENT_GATE_OVERRIDE
+}
+teardown() { find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true; }
+
+# ledger STATUS101 STATUS102 STATUS103 [EXTRA-SPRINT-JSON]
+ledger() {
+  jq -n --arg a "$1" --arg b "$2" --arg c "$3" --argjson x "${4:-null}" '
+    {schema_version: 1, active_cycle: "cycle-x", next_sprint_number: 104,
+     cycles: [
+       {id: "cycle-old", status: "archived", created: "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z",
+        sprints: [{global_id: 1, local_label: "sprint-1", status: "completed", created: "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"}]},
+       {id: "cycle-x", status: "active", created: "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
+        sprints: ([{global_id: 101, local_label: "sprint-1", status: $a, created: "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"},
+                   {global_id: 102, local_label: "sprint-2", status: $b, created: "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"},
+                   {global_id: 103, local_label: "sprint-3", status: $c, created: "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}]
+                  + (if $x == null then [] else [$x] end))}]}' > "$R/grimoires/loa/ledger.json"
+}
+
+# feedback GID GATE VERDICT [SPRINT_ID] [ROUND] [MEDIUM] [TS] — a feedback file whose trailer verdict-derive accepts
+feedback() {
+  local gid="$1" gate="$2" verdict="$3" sid="${4:-sprint-$1}" round="${5:-}" med="${6:-0}" ts="${7:-2026-06-01T00:00:00Z}" f prose
+  mkdir -p "$R/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-$gid"
+  if [[ "$gate" == review ]]; then f=engineer-feedback; else f=auditor-sprint-feedback; fi
+  [[ -n "$round" ]] && f="$f-r$round"
+  if [[ "$verdict" == APPROVED ]]; then
+    if [[ "$gate" == review ]]; then prose='All good'; else prose="APPROVED - LET'S FUCKING GO"; fi
+  else
+    prose=$'# Feedback\n\n## Findings\n\n- MEDIUM: something to fix'
+  fi
+  printf '%s\n\n<!-- LOA-VERDICT {"gate":"%s","verdict":"%s","counts":{"critical":0,"high":0,"medium":%s,"low":0},"sprint_id":"%s","ts":"%s"} -->\n' \
+    "$prose" "$gate" "$verdict" "$med" "$sid" "$ts" > "$R/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-$gid/$f.md"
+}
+
+# complete GID [SPRINT_ID] — review + audit APPROVED and the COMPLETED marker
+complete() {
+  feedback "$1" review APPROVED "${2:-}"
+  feedback "$1" audit APPROVED "${2:-}"
+  printf 'COMPLETED 2026-06-01T00:00:00Z\nsprint: %s\n' "${2:-sprint-$1}" > "$R/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-$1/COMPLETED"
+}
+
+# cache STATE [AGE_HOURS] [EXTRA-JQ] — .run/sprint-plan-state.json (jq now: portable, no GNU date -d)
+cache() {
+  jq -n --arg s "$1" --argjson h "${2:-0}" '
+    {schema_version: 2, plan_id: "plan-x", branch: "feature/x", state: $s,
+     timestamps: {started: "2026-06-01T00:00:00Z", last_activity: (now - $h * 3600 | floor | todate)},
+     sprints: {total: 3, completed: 0, current: "sprint-1",
+               list: [{id: "sprint-1", status: "in_progress"}, {id: "sprint-2", status: "pending"}, {id: "sprint-3", status: "pending"}]}}
+    '"${3:+| $3}" > "$R/.run/sprint-plan-state.json"
+}
+
+derive() { run --separate-stderr bash "$CK" derive --root "$R" "$@"; }
+_md5() { if command -v md5sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then md5sum | cut -d' ' -f1; else md5 -q; fi; }
+dj() { jq -r "$1" <<<"$output"; }
+
+# --- decision table: run state -------------------------------------------------
+
+@test "RCD-1 drift fixture (D-5.4): cache RUNNING, three COMPLETED markers with APPROVED trailers, ledger completed → COMPLETE; --write makes the cache say so" {
+  complete 101; complete 102; complete 103
+  cache RUNNING
+  derive --json
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  [ "$(dj '.state')" = COMPLETE ]
+  [ "$(dj '.cache_state')" = RUNNING ]
+  [ "$(dj '.drift')" = true ]
+  [ "$(dj '[.sprints[].state] | join(",")')" = "complete,complete,complete" ]
+  [ "$(dj '[.sprints[].completed_marker] | all')" = true ]
+  [ "$(dj '.written')" = false ]
+  [ "$(jq -r .state "$R/.run/sprint-plan-state.json")" = RUNNING ]   # --json alone writes nothing
+  derive --json --write
+  [ "$(dj '.written')" = true ]
+  run jq -r '[.state, .status, (.derived_at | test("^20[0-9]{2}-")), .derivation.source, .schema_version, .plan_id, .sprints.total] | map(tostring) | join(" ")' "$R/.run/sprint-plan-state.json"
+  [ "$output" = "COMPLETE COMPLETE true files 2 plan-x 3" ]
+  derive --json
+  [ "$(dj '.drift')" = false ]
+  [ -z "$(find "$R/.run" -name '*.tmp.*')" ]
+}
+
+@test "RCD-2 a stale marker whose trailers name sprint-1 of another cycle (or whose sprint: line names another sprint) is stale_marker, not counted" {
+  complete 101; complete 102; complete 103 sprint-1
+  cache RUNNING
+  derive --json
+  [ "$(dj '.sprints[2] | [.marker_present, .stale_marker, .completed_marker, .state] | map(tostring) | join(" ")')" = "true true false in_progress" ]
+  [ "$(dj '.derivation.stale_markers | join(",")')" = "sprint-103" ]
+  [ "$(dj '.state')" = RUNNING ]
+  [[ "$(dj '.notes | join(";")')" == *"sprint-103: COMPLETED marker names another sprint"* ]]
+  # trailers right, marker line wrong → still stale
+  complete 103
+  printf 'COMPLETED x\nsprint: sprint-7\n' > "$R/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-103/COMPLETED"
+  derive --json
+  [ "$(dj '.sprints[2].stale_marker')" = true ]
+  [ "$(dj '.sprints[2].state')" = awaiting_marker ]
+  # the local label is this sprint's name too
+  complete 103 sprint-3
+  derive --json
+  [ "$(dj '.sprints[2].state')" = complete ]
+  [ "$(dj '.state')" = COMPLETE ]
+}
+
+@test "RCD-3 legacy feedback (no LOA-VERDICT trailer) yields no verdict: the sprint stays incomplete and the file is named in derivation.legacy_feedback" {
+  complete 101; complete 102; complete 103
+  printf 'All good\n' > "$R/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-103/engineer-feedback.md"
+  cache RUNNING
+  derive --json
+  [ "$(dj '.sprints[2].review.verdict')" = null ]
+  [ "$(dj '.sprints[2].state')" = in_progress ]
+  [ "$(dj '.derivation.legacy_feedback | join(",")')" = "grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-103/engineer-feedback.md" ]
+  [ "$(dj '.state')" = RUNNING ]
+  derive --write
+  [ "$(jq -r '.derivation.legacy_feedback[0]' "$R/.run/sprint-plan-state.json")" = "grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-103/engineer-feedback.md" ]
+}
+
+@test "RCD-4 review and audit APPROVED without a marker is awaiting_marker (counted incomplete); a marker with the ledger row not completed is in_progress" {
+  complete 101; complete 102
+  feedback 103 review APPROVED; feedback 103 audit APPROVED
+  cache RUNNING
+  derive --json
+  [ "$(dj '.sprints[2].state')" = awaiting_marker ]
+  [ "$(dj '.state')" = RUNNING ]
+  printf 'COMPLETED x\n' > "$R/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-103/COMPLETED"
+  ledger completed completed in_progress
+  derive --json
+  [ "$(dj '.sprints[2] | [.completed_marker, .state] | map(tostring) | join(" ")')" = "true in_progress" ]
+  # an inconsistent APPROVED trailer (verdict-derive exit 1) is not APPROVED
+  ledger completed completed completed

+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+bats_require_minimum_version 1.5.0
+# =============================================================================
+# tests/unit/run-checkpoint-record-round.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 2 Task 2.5
+# (PRD FR-4(f) AC-4.6; SDD D-4.6). `run-checkpoint.sh record-round` replaces the
+# run-mode SKILL's breaker prose: the same-issue hash from the derived verdict,
+# no-progress, cycle count, timeout; a trip writes OPEN + HALTED and exits 10.
+# All files live in a temp dir.
+# =============================================================================
+
+setup() {
+  REPO="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd)"
+  CK="$REPO/.claude/scripts/run-checkpoint.sh"
+  VD="$REPO/.claude/scripts/verdict-derive.sh"
+  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/rcr.XXXXXX")"
+  mkdir -p "$T/.run" "$T/a2a"
+  B="$T/.run/circuit-breaker.json"
+  S="$T/.run/state.json"
+  printf '{"run_id":"r","state":"RUNNING","phase":"REVIEW"}\n' > "$S"
+}
+teardown() { find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true; }
+
+# fb NAME GATE VERDICT [MEDIUM] — a feedback file verdict-derive accepts
+fb() {
+  local prose
+  if [[ "$3" == APPROVED ]]; then
+    if [[ "$2" == review ]]; then prose='All good'; else prose="APPROVED - LET'S FUCKING GO"; fi
+  else
+    prose=$'# Feedback\n\n## Findings\n\n- MEDIUM: fix it'
+  fi
+  printf '%s\n\n<!-- LOA-VERDICT {"gate":"%s","verdict":"%s","counts":{"critical":0,"high":0,"medium":%s,"low":0},"sprint_id":"sprint-1","ts":"2026-06-01T00:00:00Z"} -->\n' \
+    "$prose" "$2" "$3" "${4:-0}" > "$T/a2a/$1"

+  jq -n '{state: "CLOSED",
+          triggers: {same_issue: {count: 0, threshold: 3, last_hash: null}, no_progress: {count: 0, threshold: 5},

+  breaker

+  rr --gate review --file "$T/a2a/engineer-feedback.md"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  [[ "$output" == "recorded: review CHANGES_REQUIRED — cycle 1/20, same_issue 1/3, no_progress 0/5" ]]
+  local want
+  want=$(bash "$VD" --file "$T/a2a/engineer-feedback.md" --gate review --json 2>/dev/null | jq -Sc '{verdict,counts}' | _md5)
+  run jq -r '[.state, .triggers.cycle_count.current, .triggers.same_issue.count, .triggers.same_issue.last_hash, (.history | length)] | map(tostring) | join(" ")' "$B"
+  [ "$output" = "CLOSED 1 1 $want 0" ]
+  [ "$(jq -r .state "$S")" = RUNNING ]
+}
+
+@test "RCR-2 the same hash again counts up; a different finding set resets same_issue to 1 with the new last_hash" {
+  breaker
+  fb engineer-feedback.md review CHANGES_REQUIRED 1
+  rr --gate review --file "$T/a2a/engineer-feedback.md"
+  rr --gate review --file "$T/a2a/engineer-feedback.md"
+  [ "$(jq -r .triggers.same_issue.count "$B")" = 2 ]
+  local h1; h1=$(jq -r .triggers.same_issue.last_hash "$B")
+  fb engineer-feedback.md review CHANGES_REQUIRED 2
+  rr --gate review --file "$T/a2a/engineer-feedback.md"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  [ "$(jq -r .triggers.same_issue.count "$B")" = 1 ]
+  [ "$(jq -r .triggers.same_issue.last_hash "$B")" != "$h1" ]
+  [ "$(jq -r .triggers.cycle_count.current "$B")" = 3 ]
+}
+
+@test "RCR-3 no_progress counts consecutive rounds whose counts are unchanged and resets when they change" {
+  breaker '.triggers.same_issue.threshold = 99'
+  fb engineer-feedback.md review CHANGES_REQUIRED 1
+  rr --gate review --file "$T/a2a/engineer-feedback.md"
+  [ "$(jq -r .triggers.no_progress.count "$B")" = 0 ]
+  rr --gate review --file "$T/a2a/engineer-feedback.md"
+  rr --gate review --file "$T/a2a/engineer-feedback.md"
+  [ "$(jq -r .triggers.no_progress.count "$B")" = 2 ]
+  fb engineer-feedback.md review CHANGES_REQUIRED 3
+  rr --gate review --file "$T/a2a/engineer-feedback.md"
+  [ "$(jq -r .triggers.no_progress.count "$B")" = 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "RCR-4 a trip at threshold writes state OPEN, appends one history entry, sets .run/state.json HALTED, prints TRIPPED and exits 10" {
+  breaker
+  fb auditor-sprint-feedback.md audit CHANGES_REQUIRED 1
+  rr --gate audit --file "$T/a2a/auditor-sprint-feedback.md"
+  rr --gate audit --file "$T/a2a/auditor-sprint-feedback.md"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  rr --gate audit --file "$T/a2a/auditor-sprint-feedback.md"
+  [ "$status" -eq 10 ]
+  [[ "$output" == *$'\n'"TRIPPED: same_issue: same issue hash "*" seen 3 times in a row" ]]
+  run jq -r '[.state, (.history | length), .history[0].trigger, .history[0].gate, .history[0].sprint] | map(tostring) | join(" ")' "$B"
+  [ "$output" = "OPEN 1 same_issue audit sprint-1" ]
+  [ "$(jq -r '.state + " " + .run_id' "$S")" = "HALTED r" ]
+  # a further round on an OPEN breaker still exits 10 and does not duplicate the history entry
+  rr --gate audit --file "$T/a2a/auditor-sprint-feedback.md"
+  [ "$status" -eq 10 ]
+  [ "$(jq -r '.history | length' "$B")" = 1 ]
+}
+
+@test "RCR-5 the cycle limit, the no-progress threshold and the timeout trip in that documented order" {
+  fb engineer-feedback.md review CHANGES_REQUIRED 1
+  breaker '.triggers.same_issue.threshold = 99 | .triggers.cycle_count.current = 19'
+  rr --gate review --file "$T/a2a/engineer-feedback.md"
+  [ "$status" -eq 10 ]
+  [[ "$output" == *"TRIPPED: cycle_count: 20 changes-required rounds reached the limit 20" ]]
+  breaker '.triggers.same_issue.threshold = 99 | .triggers.no_progress.count = 4 | .triggers.no_progress.last_counts = "{\"critical\":0,\"high\":0,\"medium\":1,\"low\":0}"'
+  rr --gate review --file "$T/a2a/engineer-feedback.md"
+  [ "$status" -eq 10 ]
+  [[ "$output" == *"TRIPPED: no_progress: "* ]]
+  breaker '.triggers.same_issue.threshold = 99 | .triggers.timeout.started = (now - 9 * 3600 | floor | todate)'
+  rr --gate review --file "$T/a2a/engineer-feedback.md"
+  [ "$status" -eq 10 ]
+  [[ "$output" == *"TRIPPED: timeout: run older than 8 hours" ]]
+  [ "$(jq -r .history[-1].trigger "$B")" = timeout ]
+}
+
+@test "RCR-6 APPROVED leaves every counter and the run state as they were (exit 0)" {
+  breaker '.triggers.same_issue.count = 2 | .triggers.same_issue.last_hash = "abc" | .triggers.cycle_count.current = 4 | .triggers.no_progress.count = 1'
+  cp "$B" "$T/before"

+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  [[ "$output" == "recorded: review APPROVED — breaker counters unchanged" ]]

+}

+  [ "$output" = "CLOSED 1 20 3 5 8" ]

  desc: The per-segment body scan (_bdb_hd_scan_body via _bdb_hd_segword) keeps a body line only when its first word, after wrapper stripping, is a fence verb. Shell keywords are not stripped: `if`, `then`, `else`, `elif`, `do`, `while`, `until`, and `case` arm prefixes (`x)`) are returned as the command word, so `if :; then rm -rf /; fi` or `for f in x; do git push --force; done` is dropped entirely from a nonexec-classified body. A quoted-delimiter body is also exempt from the `$(` fallback, so `$(rm -rf /)` is dropped too. Nonexec classification is reachable for bodies that the same command execute
  fail: A Bash command such as `cat <<'EOF' > t\nif :; then rm -rf /; fi\nEOF\nbash t*` (or `cat t | bash`, or `cat <<'EOF' > Makefile` + `make`) is reduced to `cat <<'EOF' > t\nEOF\nbash t*` before the fence rules run; the destructive command is neither matched nor asked about and executes.

DISS-C-002 [ADVISORY] voice=claude-headless anchor=.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh:_bdb_hd_is_safe_reader:222
  title: 
  desc: `git` and `gh` are on the safe-reader allowlist, so naming the heredoc's output file in a git/gh invocation on the same command never flips the class to interpreter. git executes configured helpers from its arguments: `git -c core.pager=./t log`, `git -c core.fsmonitor=./t status`, `git -c diff.external=./t diff`, `git config core.hooksPath dir`. gh runs `gh alias set --shell`. These are same-command executions of the heredoc body that the classifier currently accepts as non-executing.
  fail: `cat <<'EOF' > t` + `git -c core.pager=./t log` keeps nonexec; with DISS-001 unfixed any keyword-prefixed destructive line in the body runs unscanned, and even after DISS-001 a non-verb payload (e.g. a credential exfil) bypasses the intended fence class.

DISS-C-003 [ADVISORY] voice=claude-headless anchor=.claude/hooks/compliance/implement-gate.sh:check_implement_marker:545
  title: 
  desc: The new sanctioned_marker path grants an allow in every mode, including deny, whenever .run/implement-active.json exists with skill implement|bug and a started_at within two hours. The marker is written by run-checkpoint.sh mark, i.e. by the model through the Bash tool, which this gate does not see and which block-destructive-bash does not block. The same file's header states the tighten-only rule for model-authored claims (sprint-250 n17/n18: a claim may add an ask, never grant an allow); the marker is a model-authored claim that grants an allow and lifts the deny fence for two hours. The Wri
  fail: Under implement_gate.mode: deny, a session denied on an App Zone write runs `.claude/scripts/run-checkpoint.sh mark implement S-1` (or `printf '{...}' > .run/implement-active.json`) via Bash and every subsequent App Zone write is allowed with decision sanctioned_marker for two hours, with no ask.

        IDX_FILE="$TMPWORK/nonexec.idx"

        while IFS="$US" read -r idx b64; do
            [[ -n "$idx" ]] || continue
            cmd="$(printf '%s' "$b64" | base64 --decode 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$b64" | base64 -D 2>/dev/null || true)"

# Sprint 1 Review Feedback

**Reviewer:** Senior Tech Lead Reviewer Agent
**Date:** 2026-10-23
**Sprint Reference:** grimoires/loa/sprint.md
**Implementation Report:** grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/reviewer.md
**Change under review:** `pr/head.diff` (sprint-256: inert controls repaired or retired, file-authoritative run position, fail-closed heredoc classifier, profiles, prose-diet fallback; 68 files)

---

## Overall Assessment

The sprint lands a large amount of well-structured work: the implement-gate mode matrix (33 bats cases, the new matrix IG-24..IG-33 passes here), the profile library (17/17 bats cases pass), the Agent Teams table prune with its lint invariant (lint-invariants 9/9, test-lint-invariants 18/18), the per-task surgical-diff state (10/11 cases pass; the one failure is a `noexec` /tmp artifact of this environment), and a fence corpus that replays clean on the new hook (benign 89/89, dangerous 142/142, p95 62 ms).
